# IEEE Computer Society

> The world's leading computing and engineering professional society providing membership, publications, conferences, standards, education, and volunteer opportunities for 375,000+ members globally.

IEEE Computer Society is a premier organization advancing computing research and practice through peer-reviewed publications (including Computer and IEEE Transactions on Computers journals), premier conferences (CVPR, SC, IEEE Quantum Week), technical standards development in AI, blockchain, cloud computing, and cybersecurity, and professional certifications including SWEBOK training. The organization celebrates its 80th anniversary in 2026.

## Membership & Community

- [IEEE Computer Society](https://www.computer.org): Main homepage for world's leading computing and engineering professional society
- [About the IEEE Computer Society](https://www.computer.org/about): Overview of IEEE Computer Society's mission, community, and 80-year history
- [Discover IEEE Computer Society Membership](https://www.computer.org/membership): Membership benefits including digital library access and research publication
- [Join Membership](https://www.computer.org/membership/join): IEEE Computer Society membership signup and enrollment page
- [Discover Volunteering](https://www.computer.org/volunteering): Volunteer opportunities with 375,000+ community members globally
- [Board of Governors](https://www.computer.org/volunteering/board-of-governors): IEEE Computer Society leadership, governance, and executive committee

## Technical Standards & Development

- [Standards Activities](https://www.computer.org/volunteering/boards-and-committees/standards-activities/home): IEEE Computer Society standards committees driving AI, blockchain, and cloud tech development
- [Software Engineering Body of Knowledge (SWEBOK)](https://www.computer.org/education/bodies-of-knowledge/software-engineering): SWEBOK Guide V4.0 defining software engineering knowledge areas and standards

## Publications & Research

- [Discover Publications](https://www.computer.org/publications): Peer-reviewed journals including Computer and IEEE Transactions on Computers
- [How to Get Published: Author Guidelines for IEEE Computer Society Publications](https://www.computer.org/publications/author-resources): Author guidelines and manuscript submission process for IEEE publications

## Conferences & Events

- [Discover Conferences](https://www.computer.org/conferences): Premier tech conferences including CVPR, SC, and IEEE Quantum Week

## Education & Professional Development

- [Discover Education](https://www.computer.org/education): Professional certifications, SWEBOK training, and software engineering courses
- [Education Course Catalog](https://www.computer.org/education/courses): Course catalog with AI, IoT, and smart grid academies for professional certification
- [Home | The IEEE Computer Society](https://careers.computer.org): Career resources and professional development hub for IEEE Computer Society members

## Recognition & Awards

- [Discover Awards & Fellows Page](https://www.computer.org/volunteering/awards): Technical awards, IEEE Fellows recognition, and scholarship opportunities

## Resources & Support

- [Resource Library](https://www.computer.org/resources): Career guides, curricula standards, white papers, and learning materials
- [Subscribe to Newsletters](https://www.computer.org/resources/newsletters): Subscribe to ComputingEdge, Career Accelerator, and INSIDER newsletters
